answer_1.quote: ...we present DiffTOD, a novel dialogue planning framework that leverages a diffusion language model for non-sequential dialogue planning... We evaluate on three TOD datasets (CraigslistBargain, TopDial, PersonaChat) measuring target achievement and dialogue quality...

answer_2.quote: ...we also evaluate the text quality of the dialogue plan by comparing it with the ground‑truth dialogue in the test set using reference‑based metrics, including BLEU, word‑level F1 (F1) and BERT Score...

answer_3.quote: ...we utilize the state‑of‑the‑art LLM, GPT‑4o, to provide an overall evaluation score (Ovr.) of the dialogue quality on a scale of 1 to 5... we also ask GPT‑4o to perform the same evaluations on the three criteria (Persuasive, Coherent, Overall)...

answer_4.quote: ...we recruit 5 independent volunteer annotators with good educational background and ask them to conduct a blind evaluation, comparing the conversation quality of DiffTOD and the best‑performing baseline on the CraigslistBargain dataset...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare the conversations on three criteria: Persuasive, Coherent, and Overall.
